newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo dips as mark strengthens.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo dips as mark strengthens.

text.p: The escudo was slightly easier against the mark on Monday, reflecting the general firmness of the German unit against other European currencies, dealers said.
The escudo was trading at 100.33/36 to the mark against its Friday close in Europe at 100.25/28. Dealers said there was support for the escudo between 100.40 and 100.45.
The firmer tone to the mark was attributed to the easier dollar and some fresh speculation about a delay in the European Union's plans for monetary union.
